findings.text: The reviewed run's baseline_suite value ends mid-string at '{"revision": "84df41f817943ad9f228ac90491b8faf87dbd2c1", "command": "PYTHONPATH=. .venv 2>/dev/null; true' with no closing brace, and the manifest carries no after_suite line at all, so the done_when clause requiring both arms recorded as inline JSON with full 40-character revisions is unmet; the facts survive only in the arm logs baseline_suite-1795076626750022632.log and after_suite-1795076702037084818.log (58 passed, EXIT=0 at each arm).

The twenty-run gap probe and the pinned runs at lines 20-38 come from a probe the fragment itself states is 'not committed', so the central negative result (the 2.06 s red was scheduler contention, not the queue) cannot be re-run or checked against the instrument that days later still has no file; the fragment's only reproducible artefacts are the red run and the green gate.

The fragment claims the red and every later green ran under 'the same tree and the same command', but the red run at lines 10-11 is recorded as 'PYTHONPATH=. timeout 600 .venv/bin/python -m pytest ... | tail -40' and the head gate that passed ran 'env PYTHONPATH=. sh -c PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_promotion_queue_drains_at_slot_speed.py' on host 98dci4-clu-3141 in tree /tmp/mcintos-landing-375cee6d8b21-7qufkl/tree, so the identity the fragment leans on is not what its own records show.
